title: List of psychoactive club substances

plain_text:
A psychoactive club substance is also called psychoactive rave substance, or psychoactive party substance.

Examples

			Psychedelics

			
				

*2C-B
*DMT
*DOC
*DOM
*LSD
*Mescaline
*Psilocybin mushroom

				
			
		

    	
			Dissociatives

			
				

*Ketamine

				
			
		

		
			Entactogens

			
				

*2C-B
*MDMA

*Cannabis

*Nicotine
